questions.question: What is ArrayList?
options: A dynamic collection that grows automatically
An array with a fixed size
explanations: Correct. ArrayList is a dynamic collection that grows automatically according to the number of elements added.
No. Arrays are the ones with a fixed size, not ArrayList.
No. ArrayList is a linear structure, not designed for graphs.
No. ArrayList is a class of the standard library, not a primitive type.

questions.question: How do you add an element to an ArrayList?
explanations: Correct. The add() method adds an element to the end of the ArrayList.
No. There is no insert() method in ArrayList.
No. append() is a StringBuilder method, not an ArrayList one.
No. put() is used in Map such as HashMap, not in ArrayList.

questions.question: How do you get an element from an ArrayList?
explanations: Correct. The get(index) method returns the element at the specified position.
No. There is no at() method in ArrayList.
No. There is no fetch() method in ArrayList.
No. There is no element() method in ArrayList.

questions.question: How do you remove an element from an ArrayList?
explanations: Correct. You can use remove(index) to remove by position or remove(object) to remove a specific instance.
No. There is no delete() method in ArrayList.
No. There is no drop() method in ArrayList.
No. There is no erase() method in ArrayList.

questions.question: How do you get the size of an ArrayList?
explanations: Correct. The size() method returns the number of elements in the ArrayList.
No. length() is a String method, not an ArrayList one.
No. count() is not an ArrayList method.
No. There is no getLength() method in ArrayList.
